process_txt_data: process a txt file with pipe-delimited text and action dict pairs into a list of formatted data tuples
make_full_tree: build a grammar tree and vocabulary from a weighted list of dialogue tree datasets
tree_to_seq: linearize a nested dictionary tree into a flat sequence of tokens with span indices for transformer input
seq_to_tree: transform a linearized token sequence back into a nested dictionary tree structure with span mappings
CAIPDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that tokenizes text and linearizes instruction trees on the fly for transformer training
